validation.notes: Repaired packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts: recoverToolInvocation ignored its cancelled parameter, so a newly interrupted batch cleared the replay checkpoint and re-invoked safe/safe tools. The guard now requires !cancelled before safe replay; cancelled calls read the durable checkpoint and publish interrupted evidence (checkpoint content/details plus the unknown-outcome marker, isError true) without clearing or invoking. The regression loads the real module via .prale-eval/subject.mjs and asserts: cancelled safe/safe produces events ['read','publish'], zero effects, preserved checkpoint content/details and marker, no live result; non-cancelled safe/safe produces ['clear','invoke','effect-complete','publish'] with exactly one effect and the live non-error result settled after completion; non-replayable cases keep publishing interrupted evidence under both cancellation states. Verified the regression exits 0 on the fixed code and exits 1 with an AssertionError on the original fault when the !cancelled guard is removed. No optional dependencies or network were needed; no validation limitations.
